required_engineering_checks: The real sources catalog validates with zero approved teachers; no fixture leaks into methods.json.
Clone four synthetic related teachers and one unrelated teacher; exact-topic enumeration returns all four in teacher_id order regardless of input ordering, not a global top-K.
Explicit limit=3 returns three teachers plus the fourth in pending; offset=3 reports earlier entries without asserting they completed.

Unknown taxonomy, unknown skill/source, altered quote/locator, omitted condition, failed audit gate, unapproved teacher, syllabus-only source, quarantined source file, content-hash drift and cross-teacher retrieval fail closed.
Model-provided name/link/free-form answer/step, booleans in integer fields, malformed/truncated output and arbitrary uncertainty strings are rejected.

A result with changed growth answer 625.00 is rejected. A syntactically consistent growth_from_base/base5000/625.00 answer is also rejected when the original question says current5000. Changed rate, amount or units fail original-question binding; general arithmetic operands need an input or prior-calculation origin. Valid evidence_checked never claims semantic_verified=true.
Different conditional results are flagged as conflict or interpretation differences, never resolved by majority vote.
Missing, skipped, retrieval failure, filter unavailable, timeout and invalid teacher results remain explicit; valid peers can still display.
Output capacity moves undisplayed teachers to a complete pending list; oversized inventory raises instead of silently truncating.
Malformed or injected state cannot invent teachers/skills; new questions clear old arithmetic context; followup expires after eight turns.
Rendering escapes model/material markup, fills names and pinned source links only from audited catalog and ignores supplied derived-catalog fields unless they exactly recompute.
Native max-three concurrency, hard retrieval metadata filters and model/embedding capabilities require future real graph tests; not claimed by this model-free fallback.

Long-form logic, language, shenlun semantic entailment, current-law factual checks, OCR, preferences and teacher expansion are not implemented by the empty fallback; it asks for inputs rather than inventing answers.
